title: RAGForge SourceConnector SPI v1
description: The provider-neutral contract shared by Java and Python connector implementations.

output.metadata: source metadata without content text or credentials

fetch.sideEffects: source read only; persistence belongs to the ingestion pipeline

commitCheckpoint.sideEffects: atomic checkpoint update after successful persistence evidence

meaning.ADD: A stable source object was not present at the previous successful checkpoint.
meaning.MODIFY: The stable source object remains at the same canonical path and its source version or content hash changed.
meaning.MOVE: The stable source object remains identifiable but its canonical path changed; basename is not identity.
meaning.DELETE: The stable source object is absent from the current source view; historical revisions remain auditable.
meaning.UNCHANGED: The stable source object and source version are unchanged; no new revision or artifact is created.

changeKinds.wireRule: Only canonical names are emitted on the v1 wire contract.

algorithm: Remove a single leading './' only after resolving the source root.
Reject absolute paths, drive-qualified paths, NUL, empty segments, '.' and '..' segments.
Apply include/exclude rules to the resulting relative path.
Preserve case; case sensitivity is a source capability, not a basename identity rule.
pathNormalization.canonicalForm: relative slash-separated UTF-8 path without backslash or dot segments

includeExclude.include: An empty include list means all supported paths.
includeExclude.exclude: Exclude wins over include; matching is against canonical paths only.
includeExclude.unsupportedPath: A path failing normalization is rejected and never emitted as a change.

identity.duplicateBasenameRule: Two source objects with the same basename remain distinct when their canonical paths or stableSourceObjectId values differ.
identity.moveRule: A MOVE retains sourceDocumentId when stableSourceObjectId is stable; it creates a new revision only when content changes or downstream policy requires it.
identity.crossSpaceRule: spaceId is mandatory on every source, checkpoint, change set, document and revision reference; mismatches are rejected.

credentialHandling.privateInput: credentialRef may be resolved into a connector-private configuration object before invocation.
credentialHandling.loggingRule: Log only credentialConfigured=true|false and stable identifiers; never log credentialRef or its value.
credentialHandling.egressRule: A connector never silently switches from a local source route to a cloud route.

advanceOnlyWhen: Every non-UNCHANGED change has its immutable revision persisted.
The source and derived artifacts are persisted and content-addressed.
The parse report is persisted, including an observable OCR_UNAVAILABLE/BLOCKED result when OCR cannot run.
The active pointer is updated only to a successful immutable revision.
The corresponding outbox record is durably persisted in the same transaction boundary.
checkpointSafety.failureRule: Parser, object storage, OCR, database, or outbox failure preserves the previous checkpoint and active pointer and produces an observable retryable or permanent failure.
checkpointSafety.unchangedRule: UNCHANGED may be acknowledged without creating a revision; the checkpoint may advance only after the complete change set is durably committed.
